title: personal-okrs-weekly-checkin-ellie-khan-2026-03-04
content:
Weekly check-in: personal OKRs and action items (rough notes)

Context: end of Q1 ramp — primary focus on latency reduction for multi-tenant inference path and stable KV cache behavior for long-context models. Quick notes from the week and plan for next week.

Objective 1: Reduce 95th percentile latency for hosted-api text generation by 20% vs Feb baseline
- KR1.1: Implement prioritized batching heuristics in runtime (target: reduce per-token dispatch overhead) — status: in progress (~60%); merged initial change to feature branch; local benchmarks show 12% reduction on seq=256.
- KR1.2: Add end-to-end synthetic workload (50k requests) to CI to catch regressions — status: blocked; infra quota limits, raised with SRE (JIRA-ENG-1421).
- Current confidence: 65%
- Blockers: infra quota + some flaky network emulation on CI; need help from SRE to provision burst runners.

Objective 2: Improve tooling for model version rollouts to reduce manual ops
- KR2.1: Draft rollout runbook for canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% flows — status: draft complete; needs review from product/console team.
- KR2.2: Add automated health-check gating to console (telemetry hooks) — status: 20% (spike done).
- Next steps: sync w/ Jamie Li to align on console telemetry fields (schedule Tue 3/9).

Objective 3: Personal development — mentoring and knowledge share
- KR3.1: Run two office-hours sessions for junior engineers on KV cache internals — status: 1/2 done; good turnout, recorded.
- KR3.2: Write short doc on debugging latency regressions (templates + common pitfalls) — status: draft 40% done.

This week accomplishments (quick bullets):
- Landed batching heuristic proto and landed perf improvements on feature branch
- Ran local perf suite for long sequences and gathered traces
- Wrote draft rollout runbook and got initial ack from product
- Mentored 2 engineers during office hours; got positive feedback

Risks / asks:
- SRE: need temporary quota bump for CI burst runners to run synthetic workload (linked JIRA-ENG-1421).
- Product/Console: review rollout runbook and confirm telemetry keys for gating (pinged Jamie).
- Time: next two weeks look heavy with release prep — may need to deprioritize KR3.2 unless I carve out dedicated slots.

Plan for next week:
- Primary: unblock and run synthetic workload in CI; if SRE provisioning delayed, run scaled local cluster test as contingency.
- Finish rollout gating spike and open a PR with telemetry schema.
- Schedule second office hours and finish debugging doc draft (goal: 50% -> review by Maya).

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Consider a small canary metric: token-time-per-core to isolate kernel stalls
- Add a short checklist in runbook for rollback criteria (latency delta, error spike, 5xx rate)
- Follow up with infra on post-mortem template for flaky CI runs

Action items (this doc):
- [ ] Follow up with SRE on JIRA-ENG-1421 (due: 2026-03-05)
- [ ] Schedule review with Jamie (due: 2026-03-09)
- [ ] Share debugging doc draft with Maya for comments (due: 2026-03-11)

End of notes. (This is a working scratchpad — copy to personal OKRs page when final.)
